name: Returning customer upsell
product_or_service: Running shoes; the store also carries insoles, socks, and a shoe care kit
customer_persona: A repeat customer who is happy with a previous purchase and is back to buy the same shoes again.
personality_traits: in a bit of a hurry
objections_focus: doesn't think they need anything extra
in a hurry, wants to grab and go
goal: Practice a natural, non-pushy upsell (insoles, socks, or the care kit) without slowing the customer down or annoying them.
